name: the-paper-island
description: A tactile interactive 3D pop-up storybook for web, iOS and Android.

scripts.check: node --check src/main.js && node --check server.mjs && node --check build.mjs
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run build && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run build && npx cap add ios
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
